new:
The SADb application in Chapter~\ref{ch:database} makes physiological evidence searchable by sensory pathway, animal or human study context, and modeling relevance. Linked records, curation notes, and citation navigation connect findings to their sources. This resource helps researchers compare evidence and select pathways for neuromechanical models.

The tools in Chapter~\ref{ch:sns} turn selected pathways into testable neural--mechanical models: the Li--Deng/W2L and Gait2392 implementations, SNS-Simscape blocks, MuJoCo--Simulink integration, and staged tuning and intervention procedures. Demonstrations establish matched-circuit agreement, corrective feedback, command and measurement exchange, and pathway-dependent stepping under specified support. These tests provide a repeatable framework for comparing neural and mechanical hypotheses. General controller transfer and independent balance remain open.
